columns.description: Transaction number of the system transaction.

columns.description: Determines if the transaction is excluded from cash positioning and forecasting calculation. Valid values are Yes  or No.

columns.description: Source of transaction. For example, accounts receivable receipts, accounts payable payments, payrolls, external cash transactions and bank statements.

columns.name: FLOW_INDICATOR
